title: Simple Baselines are Competitive with Code Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2602.16805v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Code evolution is a family of techniques that rely on large language models to search through possible computer programs by evolving existing code. While code evolution pipelines have shown impressive performance across domains, many are highly complex and are typically not compared to simpler alternatives. To prevent bad comparisons from stagnating the field, we propose two simple baselines and compare them to popular pipelines across several domains: finding better mathematical bounds, designing agentic scaffolds, developing heuristic combinatorial optimization algorithms, and machine learning competitions. Surprisingly, the baselines match or outperform existing methods across all domains, prompting a closer look at which factors drive performance in different settings. For mathematical bounds, we find that the search space matters far more than the exact search algorithm, with both simple and complex methods performing similarly

translated_title: 简单基线与代码进化方法同样具有竞争力
translated_abstract: 代码进化是一类依赖大语言模型通过演化现有代码来搜索可能计算机程序的技术。虽然代码进化流程在多个领域展现出了令人瞩目的性能，但其中许多方法高度复杂，且通常未与更简单的替代方案进行比较。为了防止糟糕的比较阻碍该领域的发展，我们提出了两个简单的基线方法，并将它们与流行的流程在多个领域进行比较：寻找更优的数学边界、设计智能体脚手架、开发启发式组合优化算法以及机器学习竞赛。令人惊讶的是，这些基线在所有领域中都能匹敌甚至超越现有方法，这促使我们更深入地审视不同设置下驱动性能的因素。对于数学边界问题，我们发现搜索空间的影响远大于具体的搜索算法，简单方法与复杂方法的表现相近。
tldr: 本文提出两个简单基线方法，在数学边界优化、智能体脚手架设计、组合优化和机器学习竞赛等多个领域中与复杂的代码进化流程表现相当甚至更优，并揭示搜索空间比具体搜索算法对性能的影响更为关键。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes two simple baselines that match or outperform complex code evolution pipelines across multiple domains, revealing that the search space matters far more than the specific search algorithm.
